export BASHSIGNIFY_TRUSTED_KEYS_DIR="$HOME/pkg-fixture/trusted" BASHSIGNIFY_REVOKED_KEYS="$HOME/pkg-fixture/not-revoked"
F="$HOME/pkg-fixture"
snapshot() {
/usr/bin/python3 - "$1" <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,pathlib,stat,sys
root=pathlib.Path('root'); out={}
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
 s=p.lstat(); k=p.relative_to(root).as_posix()
 if stat.S_ISREG(s.st_mode): out[k]=['file',stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode),hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()]
 elif stat.S_ISDIR(s.st_mode): out[k]=['dir',stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode)]
 elif stat.S_ISLNK(s.st_mode): out[k]=['link',str(p.readlink())]
 else: raise RuntimeError('unexpected fixture object')
pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(out,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
PY
}
builtin pkg install "$F/valid.pkg" --root root > "$HOME/first.out" 2> "$HOME/first.err"
printf 'first=%s\n' "$?"
snapshot "$HOME/before.json"
builtin pkg install "$F/bad-data.pkg" --root root > "$HOME/second.out" 2> "$HOME/second.err"
rc=$?; printf 'rejected=%s\n' "$rc"
snapshot "$HOME/after.json"
/usr/bin/cmp -s "$HOME/before.json" "$HOME/after.json" && printf 'tree=unchanged\n' || printf 'tree=changed\n'
[[ -s "$HOME/second.err" ]] && printf 'diagnostic=yes\n' || printf 'diagnostic=no\n'
